summary: Bash solution with proper conventions (set -euo pipefail, quoted variables, error messages). Workflow has pinned actions (checkout@v4), least-privilege permissions, sensible triggers. Well-factored libraries with clear separation of concerns. Minor issues: env vars LICENSE_CONFIG and LICENSE_DB_FILE set globally but used only in license-check job (could scope to that job); shellcheck and bash-n validation steps are slightly repetitive; no explicit executable bit verification. No dead code. Production-ready.
